[[File:Haunted Star.png|thumb]]

The '''Haunted Star''' is a new obtainable item introduced in the [[Update_Log#Update_Halloween_-_Halloween_2022_Update|HALLOWEEN]] update which can be purchased for {{Candies|150}} from the Navi NPC next to spawn!

==Information==
* Inside the '''Haunted Star''', you can discover 3 new exclusive units and 13 different Halloween themed skins!
* If you haven't received a {{Rarity|Mythic}} after 400 '''Haunted Stars''', you will get one guaranteed!

==Star Chances==
<div style="font-family: 'Fredoka One',rubik,helvetica,arial,sans-serif;">

* <span style="color: #7c04f5;">Epic Skin: 16.0%</span>
* ⭐<span style="color: #ffc71e;">Legendary Skin: 2.0%</span>
* 🎃<span style="position: relative; background: linear-gradient(0, #76f1ff 30%, #fe56ff 50%, #ffec62 60%, #fe56ff 77%); -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;">Mythic Skin: 0.25%<span class="Tsh(Game) mobile-hidden" style="position: absolute; z-index: -1; left: 0;">Mythical</span></span>
* 👻<span style="color: #e01419;">Mythic Unit: 0.25%</span>
</div>
